name: comp-216
title: Overlapping Label Select
blurb: Select with label that floats over the top edge.
description: A select field with an absolutely positioned, floating label that overlaps the border using -translate-y-1/2 and a background to appear attached.
use_when: A modern floating label style that saves vertical space and clarifies field purpose.
avoid_when: When space is ample or when you prefer traditional below-field labels.
a11y: Label is associated via htmlFor; positioning is visual only.
